title: Printed Skin That Heals Wounds in 2 Minutes 😱
script: A handheld printer rolled over an open wound — and sealed it in under two minutes. Researchers at the University of Toronto built a skin-printing gun in 2020 that deposits living skin cells directly onto a wound. No donor site, no surgery, no waiting. The device lays down layers of bio-ink — collagen and fibrin — matching the patient's own tissue. Burn victims and diabetic ulcer patients were first in line. The printed skin actually integrates and heals. Would you let a printer repair your body?
search_summary: University of Toronto handheld skin printer deposits living cells onto wounds in under two minutes
comment_question: Would you trust a handheld printer to heal your open wound? 🤯
